description_en: Converts a document (such as an Office document) asynchronously and returns a TaskId after the conversion is complete
description_zh: 采用异步请求方式进行文档（例如Office文档）格式的转换，执行完成后返回TaskId
kebab_example: aliyun imm create-office-conversion-task --project immdoctest --src-uri oss://bucket1/object --tgt-uri oss://bucket1/imm-format-convert-tgt/session123/ --api-version 2017-09-06 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateOfficeConversionTask

parameters.help_en: The project name
parameters.help_zh: 项目名称
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en:
The storage location of the source data.

The OSS address follows the format `oss://bucket/object`, where bucket is the name of an OSS bucket in the same region as the current project, and object is the file path
parameters.help_zh:
源数据的存储位置。

OSS地址规则为`oss://bucket/object`，其中bucket为和当前项目处于同一区域的OSS Bucket名称，object为文件路径
parameters.name: src_uri

parameters.help_en:
The target file type for the conversion output. Valid values:

vector: converts to a vector format file that requires a preview engine for rendering before it can be previewed.

png: converts to a PNG image file.

jpg: converts to a JPG image file.

pdf: converts to a PDF file.

text: converts to a text-only file, primarily used for extracting text content from the file.

    > The source data type supports only presentation documents and word processing documents
parameters.help_zh:
转换输出的目标文件类型。包括如下选项：

vector：转换为向量格式的文件，需要使用预览引擎进行渲染后才能预览。

png：转换为PNG格式的图片文件。

jpg：转换为JPG格式的图片文件。

pdf：转换为PDF文件。

text：转换为只包含文本内容的文件，主要用于提取文件的文本内容。

    > 源数据类型只支持演示文档和文字文档类型。
parameters.name: tgt_type

parameters.help_en:
The destination location for the converted output. Set TgtUri and SrcUri to the same OSS bucket for easier permission management. 

The generated target files are persistently stored. Set this parameter to the /imm-format-convert-tgt/${name} path under the OSS bucket for easier maintenance.

You can manually delete the converted target files. If you do not delete them, they are retained for long-term use but consume storage space. To automatically delete target files, configure OSS lifecycle rules (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31904.html) under the /imm-format-convert-tgt prefix
parameters.help_zh:
转换后输出内容的目标位置，建议TgtUri和SrcUri在同一个OSS Bucket中，便于权限管理。 

生成的目标文件会持久化保存，推荐设置为OSS Bucket下的/imm-format-convert-tgt/${name}路径，便于维护管理。

您可以主动删除转换后的目标文件，如果不主动删除则会长期保留以备使用，但是会占用存储空间。如果希望自动的删除目标文件，您也可以在/imm-format-convert-tgt前缀下配置OSS的生命周期 (https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/31904.html)
parameters.name: tgt_uri

parameters.help_en: The TopicName for asynchronous reverse notifications
parameters.help_zh: 异步反向通知的TopicName
parameters.name: notify_topic_name

parameters.help_en:
The endpoint for asynchronous reverse notifications. The document conversion status can be asynchronously sent to the caller through this endpoint. To use this feature, activate Message Service (MNS) first, create a topic and queue, and configure the subscription relationship.

MNS and Intelligent Media Management (IMM) must be in the same region
parameters.help_zh:
异步反向通知的Endpoint，文档转换状态可以通过该Endpoint异步通知给调用者。使用此功能需要先开通MNS服务，新建topic和queue，并配置订阅关系。

MNS服务和智能媒体管理必须处于同一地域
parameters.name: notify_endpoint

parameters.help_en:
The suffix type of the source data. By default, the source data type is determined by the suffix of the OSS object.

Set this parameter when the OSS object does not have a suffix
parameters.help_zh:
当OSS对象没有后缀名时，可以设置此参数。

源数据的后缀类型。默认根据OSS对象的后缀名确定源数据的类型
parameters.name: src_type

parameters.help_en: The start page for document conversion. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 文档转换的起始页，默认值为1
parameters.name: start_page

parameters.help_en: The end page for document conversion. Default value: 200. To convert all pages, set this parameter to -1
parameters.help_zh: 文档转换的结束页，默认值为200。如果需要转换所有页，设置此参数为-1
parameters.name: end_page

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of rows for spreadsheet document conversion. Default value: 1000. To convert all rows, set this parameter to -1
parameters.help_zh: 表格文档转换的最大行数，默认值为1000。如果需要转换所有行，设置此参数为-1
parameters.name: max_sheet_row

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of columns for spreadsheet document conversion. Default value: 100. To convert all columns, set this parameter to -1
parameters.help_zh: 表格文档转换的最大列数，默认值为100。如果需要转换所有列，设置此参数为-1
parameters.name: max_sheet_col

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of sheets for spreadsheet document conversion. To convert all sheets, set this parameter to -1
parameters.help_zh: 表格文档转换的最大Sheet数。如果需要转换所有Sheet，设置此参数为-1
parameters.name: max_sheet_count

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to pdf.
    
Specifies whether to output all content of a sheet to a single page when converting a spreadsheet document to PDF
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为pdf时，此参数才生效。
    
表格文档转换为pdf时，是否将Sheet的所有内容输出到一页
parameters.name: sheet_one_page

parameters.help_en: The model ID. This parameter is currently unavailable
parameters.help_zh: 模型ID。此参数暂不可用
parameters.name: model_id

parameters.help_en: The password to open the document. Set this parameter if you need to convert a password-protected document
parameters.help_zh: 文档的打开密码。如果需要转换有密码的文档，请设置此参数
parameters.name: password

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to jpg, png, or pdf.

The prefix for the converted file name. The prefix can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and cannot exceed 256 characters in length.

You can customize the converted file name by setting TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix.

If TgtType is set to jpg, the naming rules for target files vary depending on the TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix settings:

If both TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix are empty, the target file name is [x].jpg.

If TgtFilePrefix is empty and TgtFileSuffix is aa, the target file name is [x]aa.

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is empty, the target file name is aa[x].

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is bb, the target file name is aa[x]bb.

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is def, the target file name is aa[x].jpg.

[x] represents multiple target files, starting from 1. For example, if TgtFilePrefix is aa, TgtFileSuffix is bb, and the converted file has 3 pages, the target files are aa[1]bb, aa[2]bb, and aa[3]bb
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为jpg、png、pdf时，此参数才生效。

转换后的文件名称前缀，可以是英文、数字、横划线和下划线，且长度不超过256个字符。

通过设置TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix，可以实现自定义转换后的文件名称。

如果TgtType设置为jpg，TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix设置不同时，目标文件的名称规则如下：

当TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix均为空时，则目标文件的名称为[x].jpg。

当TgtFilePrefix为空，TgtFileSuffix为aa时，则目标文件的名称为[x]aa。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为空时，则目标文件的名称为aa[x]。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为bb时，则目标文件名称为aa[x]bb。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为def时，则目标文件名称为aa[x].jpg。

其中[x]表示多个目标文件，从1开始。如果TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为bb，且转换后的文件有3页，则所有的目标文件为aa[1]bb、aa[2]bb、aa[3]bb
parameters.name: tgt_file_prefix

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to jpg, png, or pdf.

The suffix for the converted file name. The suffix can contain letters, digits, hyphens (-), and underscores (_), and cannot exceed 256 characters in length. The value def is reserved and indicates the default suffix.

You can customize the converted file name by setting TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix.

If TgtType is set to jpg, the naming rules for target files vary depending on the TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix settings:

If both TgtFilePrefix and TgtFileSuffix are empty, the target file name is [x].jpg.

If TgtFilePrefix is empty and TgtFileSuffix is aa, the target file name is [x]aa.

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is empty, the target file name is aa[x].

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is bb, the target file name is aa[x]bb.

If TgtFilePrefix is aa and TgtFileSuffix is def, the target file name is aa[x].jpg.

[x] represents multiple target files, starting from 1. For example, if TgtFilePrefix is aa, TgtFileSuffix is bb, and the converted file has 3 pages, the target files are aa[1]bb, aa[2]bb, and aa[3]bb
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为jpg、png、pdf时，此参数才生效。

转换后的文件名称后缀，可以是英文、数字、横划线和下划线，且长度不超过256个字符。其中def为保留字，表示采用默认的后缀名。

通过设置TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix，可以实现自定义转换后的文件名称。

如果TgtType设置为jpg，TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix设置不同时，目标文件的名称规则如下：

当TgtFilePrefix和TgtFileSuffix均为空时，则目标文件的名称为[x].jpg。

当TgtFilePrefix为空，TgtFileSuffix为aa时，则目标文件的名称为[x]aa。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为空时，则目标文件的名称为aa[x]。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为bb时，则目标文件名称为aa[x]bb。

当TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为def时，则目标文件名称为aa[x].jpg。

其中[x]表示多个目标文件，从1开始。如果TgtFilePrefix为aa，TgtFileSuffix为bb，且转换后的文件有3页，则所有的目标文件为aa[1]bb、aa[2]bb、aa[3]bb
parameters.name: tgt_file_suffix

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to jpg, png, or pdf.

The specific pages to output after conversion. You can specify up to 100 pages. If more than 100 pages are needed, submit multiple conversion requests. By default, all pages are output. For example, if TgtFilePages is set to "1, 2, 100", only pages 1, 2, and 100 are output to the destination
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为jpg、png、pdf时，此参数才生效。

转换后输出指定文件页数，最多指定100个页数，如果超过100页，请分多次转换进行提交，默认输出所有页。例如当TgtFilePages设置为"1, 2, 100"时，只会输出第1、2、100页到目标位置
parameters.name: tgt_file_pages

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to pdf.

Specifies whether to fit all rows to a single page when converting a spreadsheet document to PDF. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为pdf时，此参数才生效。

表格文档转换为pdf时，将行全部输出到一页，默认值为false
parameters.name: fit_to_pages_tall

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when TgtType is set to pdf.

Specifies whether to fit all columns to a single page when converting a spreadsheet document to PDF. Default value: false
parameters.help_zh:
当TgtType设置为pdf时，此参数才生效。

表格文件转pdf时，将列全部输出在一页，默认值为false
parameters.name: fit_to_pages_wide

parameters.help_en:
<notice>This parameter has been taken offline.</notice>
The idempotency token. UUID format is recommended. Generate a unique idempotency token for each request. The idempotency token is valid for approximately 43,200 seconds. Do not reuse the same idempotency token.

If an idempotency token is specified and two requests are identical (including the IdempotentToken parameter itself), the same result is returned, meaning the same TaskId is returned. This feature prevents duplicate task executions and avoids consuming additional compute resources.

If an HTTP status code of 5xx such as ServiceUnavailable occurs, the IdempotentToken may become invalid, and the task may be created again
parameters.help_zh:
<notice>该参数已下线></notice>
幂等标识，建议使用UUID格式。不同请求请生成独立的幂等标识。幂等标识的有效期约为43200秒，但不建议复用同一个幂等标识。

当传入幂等标识时，如果两次请求完全一致（包括IdempotentToken本身），则会返回相同结果，即返回相同的TaskId。该功能用于避免多次执行同样的任务，消耗额外计算资源。

当出现ServiceUnavailable等HTTP状态码为5xx的异常时，IdempotentToken可能失效。此时可能会重复创建该任务
parameters.name: idempotent_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use vector mode when converting PDF to VECTOR. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Uses vector mode. The preview is clearer, but the conversion takes longer.

false: Uses image mode. The preview quality is average, but the conversion is faster
parameters.help_zh:
当PDF转换为VECTOR时，是否使用向量模式，默认值为false。包括如下选项：

true：使用向量模式，预览效果比较清晰，但是转换耗时较长。

false：使用图片模式，预览效果一般，但是转换耗时较短
parameters.name: pdf_vector

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to hide comments and apply revisions when converting WORD or PPT to VECTOR, JPG, or PNG. Default value: false. Valid values:

true: Hides comments and applies revisions.

false: Displays comments and revisions
parameters.help_zh:
当WORD、PPT转换为VECTOR、JPG、PNG时，是否隐藏批注和应用修订，默认值为false。包括如下选项：

true：隐藏批注和应用修订。

false：显示批注和修订
parameters.name: hidecomments

parameters.help_en:
This parameter takes effect only when the source data type is converted to JPG or PNG.

The image resolution in PPI. Default value: 96. Valid values: 96 to 2048
parameters.help_zh:
当源数据类型转换为JPG、PNG时，此参数才生效。

图片分辨率，默认值为96，单位为PPI，取值范围为96~2048
parameters.name: display_dpi

parameters.help_en: The custom user data. This value is returned as-is in MNS notifications
parameters.help_zh: 用户自定义数据，在mns通知中原样返回
parameters.name: user_data

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the task was created

Percent.description_en:
The task progress percentage. Currently, only two values are returned: 0 and 100.

This parameter returns 100 only when the conversion succeeds. In all other cases, the value is 0
Percent.description_zh:
任务进度的百分比。当前只有0和100两个结果。

只有当转换成功时，此参数的返回值才为100，其他情况均为0

Status.description_en:
The task execution status. Valid values:

Running: The task is running.
Finished: The task is complete and the conversion succeeded.
Failed: The task is complete and the conversion failed
Status.description_zh:
任务运行状态。包括如下选项：

Running：任务运行中。
Finished：任务执行完成，转换成功。
Failed：任务执行完成，转换失败

TaskId.description_en:
The task ID.

You can obtain the TaskId of an asynchronous document conversion task from the task query tab of the corresponding project in the Intelligent Media Management (IMM) console
TaskId.description_zh:
任务ID。

异步文档格式转换任务的TaskId可以通过智能媒体管理控制台对应项目的任务查询页签获取

TgtLoc.description_en: The location of the output target file. This value is the same as the TgtUri request parameter
TgtLoc.description_zh: 输出目标文件的位置，和请求参数中的TgtUri相同
